answer: The reef schedule is applied in pulse and walnut reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1304 identities would post 3733 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
